_note: Example of config/manual_free_agents.json, the gitignored fallback for get_free_agents while Yahoo access is pending. Copy Yahoo's available-players page into this shape (made-up players here). Booth stops using the real file 7 days after as_of.
note: Dan's saved copy of Yahoo's available-players list: offense only (no kickers or defenses), the 50 most-rostered available players. Players may have been claimed since as_of. 'waivers until <date>' means a FAAB claim that processes on that date; 'free agent' means an instant add until his game kicks off, when he goes on waivers. week4_proj_pts is Yahoo's projection for week 4, a rough guide to role only.
